boundary_hidden_state_contract: Hidden states cross the cut as IntermediateTensors between pipeline stages (model.py IntermediateTensors plumbing); the stage-[20,40) consumer receives the stage-[0,20) producer output tensors plus their layouts.

cache_lifetime_invalidation_reconstructi.invalidation: Freed on completion (_free_request -> _free_blocks); deferred through deferred_frees when an in-flight GPU step may still write them, drained by _drain_deferred_frees after the fence step; prefix cache reset via reset_prefix_cache; preemption frees blocks and resets num_computed_tokens=0.
cache_lifetime_invalidation_reconstructi.lifetime: Request-scoped: blocks are owned via req_to_blocks[request_id] (kv_cache_manager) from allocation to free.
cache_lifetime_invalidation_reconstructi.reconstruction: Preempted requests requeue to the waiting queue and recompute from token 0; failed KV loads under recompute policy reset num_computed_tokens=0 for recomputation (scheduler).
cache_lifetime_invalidation_reconstructi.source_binding: All semantics are properties of the pinned vLLM v1 scheduler/cache manager bytes at 0eae9acd; the adapter consumes them as the substrate contract, it does not reimplement them.

cut_legality: Layer 20 is a kv-source layer and the candidate_source_layer; groups below end at 20 (nearest-source-at-or-below resolution, attention.py:331-336); no PP cut falls inside a kv-sharing group (attention.py:439-444,550-558).

dependencies.cross_stage_cache: None required at the cut: layer 20 owns its own compressed-KV cache; no consumer at layer >=21 resolves a kv source below 20 except within its own group (nearest source at or below: layer 20).
dependencies.downstream: final norm + LM head (embedding_or_head tensors) after layer 39; MTP layers 40-42 explicitly out of scope
dependencies.upstream: stage-[0,20) producer unit (hidden states, embed; engram tables 1,14 rows retained immutable)

generic_extension: None required: contiguous_stage is expressible through the existing generic opaque execution-unit/dependency/Memory Resource seams; no DeepSeek/expert/router/cache/backend noun enters generic planner code.

immutable_state.policy: All layers.[0..20). tensors of the producer stage unit, derived from the accepted R7-A census (state classes attention/router/shared_expert/backbone_or_other as attributed per layer by name pattern); no handwritten geometry.

materialization_lifetime: Selective per-unit: only tensors attributed to the stage interval are required; unrelated official tensors sharing a shard are not participants (shard-granularity acquisition distinguished from logical required bytes per Phase 4 contract).
prefill_decode_applicability: Both phases execute through the same stage units; cache authority transitions follow the pinned scheduler semantics (is_prefill_chunk derived from num_computed_tokens; preemption frees blocks, resets num_computed_tokens=0, and requeues for recomputation).
selection_rule: Only honestly supported shape: the pinned runtime exposes a truthful contiguous backbone cut with explicit boundary hidden-state and cache ownership (IntermediateTensors boundary transfer; kv-source-owned MLAAttentionSpec caches); it exposes no independent routed-expert-bank execution seam (experts execute inside whole-layer MoE forward), so expert_local is not supportable without hidden whole-model execution.

session_mutable_state.kv_cache: Compressed-KV and indexer-K caches owned exclusively by kv-source layers 2,8,14 (below-cut sources consumed through the forward context within the producer stage) and 20 (the boundary source, owned by the consumer stage); MLAAttentionSpec cache groups (kv_cache_interface.py MLAAttentionSpec.merge asserts uniform quantization/tokens_per_state/model_version/cache_role per group).
session_mutable_state.ownership_rule: Only kv-source layers own a compressed-KV cache (attention.py get_kv_cache_spec returns None for non-sources); consumers read the source's cache through the forward context.
session_mutable_state.swa_cache: Sliding-window attention state (window_size=128) per layer with compress_ratio=0 (layers 0,1 and 40..42 MTP out of scope); allocated separately as DeepseekV4SWACache.
